title: 第5章 监狱生活(二)
content_zh:
监狱生活也并没有想象中那么惨，至少对唐峰三人来说是这样的，每天吃饱喝足就是一群人打屁吹牛，不知是什么原因，他们这个牢房从来没有参加过劳动，直到后来唐峰才知道，原来是他们这个牢房里的人都太凶了，以前每次出去劳动都会和别人干起来，反正这牢房里大部分都是死刑或死缓，也没人在乎多杀一，两个人。经过这么几次，监狱领导怕了，后来也就给这个牢房开了绿灯不用参加劳动。

总之除了没有自由，没有女人外他们和正常人的生活没什么区别。这天，唐峰几人正在喝着小酒吹牛，突然牢房门被人打开，一名狱警走了进来说：“下个星期五有领导要来检查，所有的犯人都要在操场集合迎接，上面让我告诉你们，这次千万别惹事，只要你们不惹事啥都好说，要是惹事了那就等着立刻吃枪子吧。”说完后，见众人没说话，狱警将目光定在唐峰身上说：“95441，有人探监，你跟我来。”

唐峰有些兴奋的跟着狱警走了出去，算一算他们三人来这里已经1个多月了，现在就连自己都觉得自己就是一黑社会份子了。这一天终于来了，虽说在监狱里也挺好，但他却更希望早日出去，早日开始执行他那艰巨的任务。这一段时间和那些黑社会的相处使他更期待黑社会的生活，而且他眼中的黑社会也因为这些人而改变，他不在讨厌黑社会，他甚至觉得这才是他因该过的生活，爱憎分明，不用去考虑那么多，自己想干什么就干什么，当然这并不是说他的思想动摇了，在骨子里他还是忠于国家的。

随着狱警来到探监室，唐峰隔着钢化玻璃看着对面的中年人，这个人唐峰并不认识，但他知道这人一定是张将军派来的人。

“唐峰，下个星期五张将军会来监狱视察，当然，视察是假，主要是给你创造机会，到时候你只要在监狱内部惹些乱子，然后趁乱会有人接引你。”中年人看了看四周，见没人注意悄声说道。

唐峰点了点头表示明白，思考了一会开口道：“麻烦您向张爷爷请示一下，我在监狱中认识一个人，这个人将对我以后的任务起到很关键的作用。我想将他一起带出去。”唐峰已经决定将王胜一起带出去，首先王胜这个人很合他的胃口，在者这个人在进来之前是SX省人，随说自己也是SX省人，可自己离开家乡之前还小，对SX的地下势力根本一无所知，而这个王胜就不一样了，他在SX省XA市曾今拥有不小的势力，虽然过去这么久但他好歹也是个本地黑社会，对他们的发展会起到和关键的作用。

中年人皱皱眉头想了会说：“好吧，我回去向首长汇报一下，明天在来告诉你结果，如果没有别的事我就先走了。”

唐峰点了点头，看着中年人走后随狱警回到了牢房。

回到牢房后唐峰向许强还有关智勇点了点头，随后对王胜说：“老虎，你过来，我有事和你商量。”

见唐峰说话，其他人识趣的远离唐峰身边。

“死神，啥事啊？”老虎说道。死神，唐峰曾今在部队的外号，他决定以后就以这个名号来闯荡黑社会。

唐峰看了看周围，悄声说：“想不想出去？”

“想啊，杂不想？我做梦都想出去。”老虎楞了一下答道，唐峰的话让他有些摸不着头脑，难道唐峰有办法让自己出去？

“下个星期五领导来视察的时候我们想办法出去，敢不敢？”唐峰问道。

王胜没说话，而是看了唐峰半天，随后才说道：“哥们，你没傻吧？想越狱？别的监狱好说这个监狱不可能成功的，在这里连只蚊子都飞不进来。”

“他妈的，原本还以为你是个人物，没想到你也是个软蛋。”说罢起身欲走，他这是在用激将法，他知道王胜这人好面子，话又说回来，那个混黑社会的能不好面子？

王胜一把拉住唐峰，四周看了看说：“娘的，虽然老子知道你这是激将法，但老子还就吃这一套了，你说吧，杂办，老子看的出来，你是个人物，而且你也把老子当兄弟看，要不这么重要的事你是不会告诉老子的，在加上你们三个的本事这事没准还真能成，我只想知道你为啥要带上老子？有什么企图直接挑明了，别跟个娘们一样。”

唐峰又坐回原地说：“好，是条汉子，我也不墨迹，我只需要你答应我一个条件，就是出去后跟着我混。”

王胜低着头想了想说：“说白了，兄弟你确实有本事，至少老虎我比不上你，我能看的出来你是干大事的人，跟你混也不算丢人，我答应你，但是有些违背原则的事咱可不干。”

唐峰来了兴趣问道：“哦？什么事算违背你的原则？”

王胜盯着唐峰的双眼说：“老子混黑社会，不是为啥，也就是讨口饭吃，如果有个啥手艺老子也不会干这行，跟着你混可以但是首先，杀人老子不怕但强奸咱不干，那是畜生干的事。军火老子可以搞但白面老子不沾，那东西害人害己，昧良心的钱不赚也罢。收保护费老子可以去但欺压普通老百姓老子也不干，老百姓本来讨个生活就不容易，这么缺德是事老子坚决不干。”

唐峰楞了楞，他没想到这些话会从这么个恶汉口中说出。而王胜见唐峰没说话，以为他不同意便说：“既然你不同意那老子也不废话，你放心一码归一码，你们要越狱的事老子不会打小报告。”说完就想走。

不待他起身，唐峰抓住他的手腕说：“老虎，你刚说的话说到我心坎里去了，咱们是混黑社会，不是去祸害国家，你放心，你说的那些别说你不同意，就是你想去干老子也要打你个半死。”

王胜惊喜的看着唐峰道：“死神，你说的是真的？你可别忽悠老子，老子虽然没啥头脑但老子不蠢，如果真照你说的这样老子愿意跟你，但是以后要是让老子发现你骗了老子，那就算老子干不过你老子也不会放过你。”

唐峰没有说话，只是点了点头，但他心里却异常高兴，有这么个人帮助自己，自己的胜算又大了一些。
content_en:
Prison life was not as miserable as imagined, at least for Tang Feng and the other three. They had nothing to eat and drink every day but a group of people bragging. For some reason, their cell had never participated in labor. It was not until later that Tang Feng found out that the people in their cell were too cruel. In the past, they would get into trouble with others every time they went out to work. Anyway, most of the people in this cell were sentenced to death or with a reprieve, and no one cared about killing one or two more people.After doing this several times, the prison leaders became afraid and later gave the cell the green light not to participate in labor.

In short, except for the lack of freedom and women, their lives are no different from normal people.On this day, Tang Feng and others were drinking wine and bragging. Suddenly, the cell door was opened, and a prison guard walked in and said: "Next Friday, the leaders will come to inspect, and all the prisoners will gather in the playground to greet them. The higher-ups asked me to tell you that this timeDon't cause trouble. As long as you don't cause trouble, you can say anything.If you do, you'll be shot immediately." After saying that, when no one spoke, the prison guard focused on Tang Feng and said, "95441, someone is visiting the prison.Come with me."

Tang Feng followed the prison guard out with some excitement. Counting that the three of them had been here for more than a month, even he felt like a gangster now.The day finally came. Although it was good to be in prison, he wanted to get out as soon as possible and start performing his arduous task as soon as possible.This period of time spent with those gangsters made him look forward to the life of the gangsters more, and the gangsters in his eyes have also changed because of these people. He no longer hates the gangsters, he even feels that this is the life he should live. He can clearly distinguish between love and hate, and does not need to think so much. He can do whatever he wants. Of course, this does not mean that his thoughts have wavered. In his heart, he is still loyal to the country.

As the prison guards came to the visiting room, Tang Feng looked at the middle-aged man opposite through the tempered glass. Tang Feng did not recognize this man, but he knew that this man must be someone sent by General Zhang.

"Tang Feng, General Zhang will come to the prison for inspection next Friday. Of course, the inspection is fake. It is mainly to create opportunities for you. Then you only need to cause some trouble inside the prison, and then someone will take advantage of the chaos to pick you up." The middle-aged man looked around and whispered when he saw that no one was paying attention.

Tang Feng nodded to express his understanding. After thinking for a while, he said: "Please ask Grandpa Zhang for instructions. I know a person in prison. This person will play a key role in my future tasks. I want to take him out together." Tang Feng has decided to take Wang Sheng out with him. First of all, Wang Sheng is very suitable for him.I was from SX Province before I came here, and I said that I was also from SX Province, but before I left my hometown, I was still young and knew nothing about the underground forces in SX. But this Wang Sheng is different. He once had a lot of power in XA City, SX Province. Although it has been so long, he is still a local underworld and will play a key role in their development.

The middle-aged man frowned and thought for a while and said, "Okay, I'll go back and report to the chief. I'll tell you the results tomorrow. If there's nothing else, I'll leave first."

Tang Feng nodded and watched the middle-aged man leave and follow the prison guard back to the cell.

After returning to the cell, Tang Feng nodded to Xu Qiang and Guan Zhiyong, and then said to Wang Sheng, "Tiger, come here. I have something to discuss with you."

Seeing Tang Feng talking, the others wisely stayed away from Tang Feng.

"Death, what's going on?" Tiger said.The God of Death, Tang Feng Zengjin’s nickname in the army, he decided to use this name to break into the underworld in the future.

Tang Feng looked around and whispered, "Do you want to go out?"

"Think about it, don't you? I've always dreamed of getting out." Lao Hu was stunned and replied. Tang Feng's words made him a little confused. Could Tang Feng have a way to get out?

"When the leader comes to inspect next Friday, let's find a way to get out. Do you dare?" Tang Feng asked.

Wang Sheng did not speak, but looked at Tang Feng for a long time, and then said: "Brother, are you not stupid? You want to escape from prison? Other prisons say it is impossible to succeed in this prison. Not even a mosquito can fly in here."

"Damn it, I thought you were a figure, but I didn't expect you to be a softie." After saying that, he stood up and wanted to leave. He was using a provocation method. He knew that Wang Sheng was a good person, but then again, how could that gangster not be so good?

Wang Sheng grabbed Tang Feng, looked around and said, "Damn, although I know you are trying to provoke the general, I still do this. Just tell me, miscellaneous officer, I can see that you are a person, and you also treat me as a brother."Look, otherwise you wouldn’t tell me about such an important thing. With the abilities of the three of you, it might be possible. I just want to know why you want to bring me with you.What’s your intention?Don’t act like a bitch.”

Tang Feng sat back and said, "Okay, he's a man, and I don't do ink. I just need you to agree to one condition, which is to follow me when you get out."

Wang Sheng lowered his head and thought for a moment before saying, "To put it bluntly, brother, you are indeed capable. At least I can't compare to you, Tiger. I can see that you are a person who can do great things. It's not a shame to hang out with you. I promise you, but we won't do anything that goes against our principles."

Tang Feng became interested and asked: "Oh? What is considered to be against your principles?"

Wang Sheng stared into Tang Feng's eyes and said: "The reason why I join the underworld is to beg for food. If I have any skills, I won't do this. I can follow you. But first of all, I am not afraid of murder, but rape is not what I do. That is what beasts do. ArmsI can do it, but I won’t do it because it harms others and harms me. It doesn’t matter if I don’t earn money from it.I can do it by collecting protection fees, but I won’t do it by bullying ordinary people. It’s not easy for ordinary people to make a living.It’s so immoral and I won’t do it.”

Tang Feng was stunned. He didn't expect these words to come from such a villain's mouth.When Wang Sheng saw that Tang Feng was silent, he thought he disagreed and said, "Since you don't agree, I won't talk nonsense. Don't worry, I won't report your escape from prison." After saying that, he wanted to leave.

Before he could get up, Tang Feng grabbed his wrist and said, "Tiger, what you just said goes to my heart. We are in the underworld, not to harm the country. Don't worry, don't say you don't agree with what you said. Even if you want to fuck me, I will beat you half to death."

Wang Sheng looked at Tang Feng in surprise and said: "Death, are you telling the truth? Don't fool me. Although I have no brains, I am not stupid. If it is true as you said, I am willing to follow you, but if I find out that you lied to me in the future, even if I can't do it, I will not let you go."

Tang Feng didn't speak, just nodded, but he was extremely happy in his heart. With such a person helping him, his chances of winning were better.
